figurative_meaning_en: sarcastically, a monkey (implying a foolish or mischievous person)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো লঙ্কাফেরত, কোনো কাজই ঠিকমতো করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's a real Lanka-returned monkey, can't do anything properly.
The kid is running around like a Lanka-returned monkey.
history: References the monkey army (vanara sena) led by Hanuman returning from Lanka after aiding Rama in the Ramayana epic.
note: Idiom draws from Hindu mythology, commonly used in colloquial Bengali to mock clumsiness or mischief.
